description: Permanently delete an R3 project. With the project:delete:created right (on by default), only a project YOU created (this agent key or app connection) — use it to clean up your own abandoned attempts; the user's own projects and other agents' are refused. With project:delete:owned, any project the user owns, and only when the user asked for it: pass owned: true for a project you did not create (an app connection is then asked for that right). A published project (live, or with an open preview link) is refused: it must be taken offline first. If the refusal is for a preview link (temporary, 7 days), it may be removed without a separate request (r3_preview_remove) and the delete tried again; the user is then told it was removed. If the project is live, other people can open it: it goes offline only once the user has been asked and agreed, never as a step of the delete. This is irreversible: there is no trash and no undo.

owned.description: true when the project is one of the user's own, not one you created: it needs project:delete:owned. Only when the user asked to delete it. Leave out for a project you created.

projectId.description: The project id to delete: one you created, or (with project:delete:owned) any project the user owns.

name: r3_project_delete

answer.description: This answer in words: what was done, what R3 measured, decided or refused, and what to do next. The same text as the result's text block. Read it: the fields beside it are the data, this is the guidance.

title: Delete an R3 project
